subject: Hosted API commit increase & rate-limit tier change — StreamWave
messages:
From: Olivia Reyes <olivia@streamwave.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@streamwave.ai
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Increase commit + higher rate tier for May renewal

Hi Lauren,

We’re approaching our annual renewal and want to increase our hosted API commitment. Some context: April spiked 3x after a new product launch and our average token consumption is trending higher than the current 500M/month commit. We’d like to: 

- Move to 1.5B tokens/month committed starting 2026-06-01
- Increase our rate limit tier from "standard" (50 rps) to "high-throughput" (150 rps) to support bursts
- Keep the same contract term (12 months) but review a quarterly usage-based cadence for throttling and alerts

Can you share an updated amendment and a ballpark on the committed discount versus list, plus any lead time you need to provision capacity on Dedicated/Hosted? I’ve attached a usage report for April.

Attachments: StreamWave-usage-report-April.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

—Olivia
Head of Platform, StreamWave

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Reyes <olivia@streamwave.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, contracts@streamwave.ai
Date: 2026-05-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Increase commit + higher rate tier for May renewal

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and the usage export (helpful). High level response: we can support the requested 1.5B/month commit and bump the rate tier to 150 rps on our Hosted API. A few operational notes up front: 

- Pricing: I’ll pull in Marcus (copied) to confirm exact committed-rate pricing. Ballpark: you should expect ~22–28% off list for a 1.5B commit (depending on whether you want a fixed or consumption-adjusted overage band).
- Provisioning: for Hosted we can enable the rate-tier increase within 5 business days after the amendment is signed; if you want guaranteed Dedicated capacity (SLA-backed), that lead time is 2–3 weeks depending on region.
- Autoscaling & fallback: we’ll configure a soft-fallback policy so if traffic spikes above the committed band, calls are served on a compatible quantized variant with a brief notification window.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Marcus to share pricing matrix and amendment draft.
2) We’ll push a staged rate-limit change into your account and run a smoke-test window (48–72h).
3) DocuSign amendment for signature and then provisioning.

I’ll draft the amendment and attach a PDF for legal — Marcus, can you confirm discount band and any margin for promotional credits (we have some renewal flexibility)?

Thanks,
Lauren
Account Exec — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: StreamWave — pricing / credit approval for 1.5B commit

Lauren / Tessa — quick internal note before we send the formal amendment to StreamWave:

- Pricing recommendation: 25% off list for the 1.5B commit, with a 12-month term and a 10% overage rate above the committed band for the first 90 days (then revert to standard overage). That keeps it revenue-neutral relative to usage forecasts while giving the customer a clear cushion.
- Promotional credit: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $15k to offset integration testing and the smoke test window (applies to first invoice).
- Rate-limit tier (150 rps): outline as a separate line item in the amendment (non-billable flag) with an SLA note that Dedicated availability is recommended if they need guaranteed cross-region throughput.
- Legal: I’ll attach a draft amendment (PDF) to the outbound; ask contracts to pre-approve the DocuSign template.

Technical asks for Connor: with the jump from 50 → 150 rps and 1.5B tokens, can you confirm we have the ephemeral capacity to run the 72h smoke test without throttling other hosted customers? If not, we’ll make the rate increase gated on a Dedicated prep.

Marcus
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Reyes <olivia@streamwave.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Increase commit + higher rate tier for May renewal

Hi Olivia / team — looping in engineering ops for scheduling. Quick operational summary and the plan we’ll execute once amendment is signed: 

1) Capacity check: engineering confirms we can support a 150 rps soft tier on Hosted for the smoke-test window without impacting tenant isolation. We’ll earmark extra nodes during the 72h window.
2) Smoke-test plan (48–72h): RDMA burst tests, real-token distribution replay (from your April export), latency & 95th/99th percentile tracking, and auto-rollout rollback hooks.
3) Monitoring & alerts: we’ll enable a dedicated dashboard in Console with token burn rate, rps, and early-warning anomaly alerts.
4) Cutover timeline:
   - Amendment signed (DocuSign): Day 0
   - Provision soft-rate tier: Day 1–2 (prep + dry-run)
   - Smoke-test: Day 3–5
   - Full commit enforcement: Day 6 (billing changes take effect on next invoice cycle unless we agree otherwise)

I’ll attach the draft amendment (amendment_SW-2026-145-draft.pdf) to the DocuSign envelope and schedule a short 30-min kickoff after signature to validate the replay script.

Connor
Platform Ops — Redwood Inference
